opening: Namaste! We are neighbours organising a festival for everyone in our area, and we would love your business to be part of it.

perks.title: Your name at the top of the main banner, and a thank-you from the stage.
perks.gold: Your name on the main banner, and a thank-you from the stage.
perks.supporter: Your name on the thank-you board at the entrance.

closing: If you would like to take part, or have any questions, please get in touch. We would be glad to hear from you.
rationale: A short, neighbourly note with simple perks that volunteers can deliver, and no claims beyond what you told us.
